data.key: Deep One Corruption ~ Call of the Deep Stain
data.name: Call of the Deep Stain
data.description: You require constant submersion in salt water. If you spend more than 1 day without fully submerging yourself in such water, you suffer internal organ failure, painful cracking of the skin, and death within 4d6 hours.
